papers.title: The Machinability of Ti-6Al-4V Fabricated by Laser Powder Bed Fusion with Different Build Orientations in Thermal Assisted Machining
papers.abstract: Additively manufactured titanium alloys such as Ti-6Al-4V have been used as functional components in industry due to their excellent mechanical properties. However, the machining of these alloys is a challenge due to their enhanced tensile/yield strength, low elastic modulus, poor thermal conductivity, and microstructural anisotropy. Thermal assisted machining (TAM), as a hybrid manufacturing technology, can improve the machinability of additively manufactured alloys. The main aim of this paper is to investigate the effect of temperature buildup on the machinability of additively manufactured Ti alloy with different build directions in the TAM process. It was found that the surface integrity was notably enhanced by preheating, and it was the best at 90° build orientation. Serrated chips were generated at room temperature, and curlier chips were formed in high-preheating machining environment. By analyzing the surface quality, the influence of the build-up orientation on the surface quality at different temperatures was evaluated.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文关注的是增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的热辅助加工可加工性，而非后处理对力学性能的影响，因此与层2方向相关性较低。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not evaluate the effect of post-processing on mechanical properties (tensile/fatigue) or microstructure/porosity; it focuses on machinability (cutting forces, chip morphology, surface roughness) during thermal assisted machining.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V在不同建造方向下的热辅助加工可加工性。
summary_zh.method: 通过热辅助加工实验，分析预加热温度对表面完整性、切屑形态的影响。
summary_zh.result: 预加热显著提高表面完整性，90°建造方向效果最佳；室温下产生锯齿状切屑，高温下形成卷曲切屑。
summary_zh.validation: 通过表面质量和切屑形貌的实验观察验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the machinability of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V with different build orientations during thermal assisted machining.
summary_en.method: Thermal assisted machining experiments were conducted, varying preheating temperature and build orientation, and the resulting surface integrity and chip morphology were analyzed.
summary_en.result: Preheating notably enhanced surface integrity, with the best results at 90° build orientation; serrated chips formed at room temperature while curlier chips appeared under high preheating.
summary_en.validation: The findings were validated through experimental observation of surface quality and chip morphology.

papers.title: Electric Field-Assisted Chemical Pretreatment for Enhancing Liquid Metal-Driven Abrasive Slurry Polishing of Ti-6Al-4V Internal Flow Channels
papers.abstract: Ti-6Al-4V internal flow channels are difficult to finish because direct liquid metal-driven abrasive slurry polishing is constrained by both the limited driving capability of the liquid metal and the continuous formation of a dense surface reaction layer in alkaline electrolytes. In this study, the direct polishing behavior of Ti-6Al-4V flow channels was first investigated, and a distinct polishing capability boundary was identified through the evolution of surface morphology and areal roughness Sa. Although Sa decreased with polishing time, the reduction rate gradually diminished and eventually approached a plateau, indicating pronounced attenuation in effective material removal. Mechanistic analysis revealed that this limitation was governed by the dynamic formation and disruption of the oxide/reaction layer, which progressively shields the metallic substrate from direct abrasive action. To address this issue, an electric-field-assisted chemical pretreatment was introduced prior to the liquid metal-driven abrasive polishing stage, forming a two-step route (AB + P). Comparative experiments among direct polishing (P), chemical pretreatment followed by polishing (B + P), and electric-field-assisted chemical pretreatment followed by polishing (AB + P) showed that AB + P produced more homogeneous surface morphologies, lower Sa, and a significantly weaker plateauing tendency than direct polishing. In addition, the attainable limiting surface quality was shifted to a lower level, indicating an extension of the polishing capability boundary. The influence of pretreatment electrification time further revealed the existence of an effective time window, beyond which the polishing improvement gradually saturated. These results demonstrate that electric-field-assisted chemical pretreatment is an effective strategy for mitigating polishing attenuation and enhancing the finishing capability of liquid metal-driven abrasive slurry polishing for Ti-6Al-4V internal flow channels.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究了Ti-6Al-4V内流道的抛光后处理，但未涉及增材制造或疲劳力学性能，仅作为表面处理背景参考。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address mechanical performance (fatigue/tensile) and does not specify additive-manufactured Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服液态金属驱动磨料抛光Ti-6Al-4V内流道时抛光能力受限的问题
summary_zh.method: 采用电场辅助化学预处理结合液态金属驱动磨料抛光的两步法
summary_zh.result: 两步法获得更均匀的表面形貌和更低的粗糙度，有效延缓抛光衰减
summary_zh.validation: 通过对比直接抛光、化学预处理+抛光及电场辅助预处理+抛光实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the polishing limitation of liquid metal-driven abrasive slurry for Ti-6Al-4V internal channels due to reaction layer formation.
summary_en.method: An electric-field-assisted chemical pretreatment followed by liquid metal-driven abrasive polishing (AB + P).
summary_en.result: The AB + P route produced more homogeneous surfaces, lower Sa values, and significantly reduced plateauing compared to direct polishing.
summary_en.validation: Comparative experiments among P, B + P, and AB + P with varying pretreatment electrification times.
